text:
nic: Hey team — trying to run the Ruby quickstart from the README and hitting a weird install error on macOS (M1).
nic: `gem install redwood-inference` fails with `Error: Can't find OpenSSL` even though `brew install openssl@3` is present.
nic: Any known macOS arm64 quirks or flags I should pass?

mira: @nic — ugh, mac M1 fun. What Ruby version are you on? `ruby -v` and `gem env` output would help.

nic: ruby 3.2.2p... and using rbenv. `gem env` shows OPENSSL_DIR empty. Quick repro:
```
$ gem install redwood-inference -v 0.3.2
Fetching redwood-inference-0.3.2.gem
ERROR:  Error installing redwood-inference:
        ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
An error occurred while installing ffi (1.15.5), and Bundler cannot continue.
```

sam: Looks like the failure is during building native deps (ffi) — not our gem per se. That often happens when the system OpenSSL / libffi headers aren't available.
sam: On mac: `brew install libffi` and then `export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix libffi)/lib" CFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix libffi)/include"` before `gem install` usually fixes it.

mira: Also for Apple Silicon, sometimes `arch -arm64` vs `arch -x86_64` matters depending on your homebrew prefix. Try `brew --prefix` and confirm headers exist.

nic: Thanks — quick try: `brew install libffi openssl@3` then:
```
export LDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix libffi)/lib -L$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/lib"
export CFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix libffi)/include -I$(brew --prefix openssl@3)/include"
gem install redwood-inference
```
nic: That got past the ffi build, thanks!

sam: Nice. One related DX note — the Ruby quickstart currently doesn't mention native deps for mac M1. We have at least two PRs in the backlog for README/quickstart parity with Python docs.

mira: Filing quick ticket: add macOS native deps troubleshooting section + the specific env vars above. @sam can you link the PR or open one? Should be a small docs patch.

sam: Will open PR today. Also small heads-up: our Ruby client retry behavior differs slightly from Python's — Ruby retries on 500+ by default but we don't have idempotency hinting for streaming endpoints. If someone is upgrading from Python, mention that in CHANGELOG.

leo: cc @dev-bot — can we get a tiny doc job to validate quickstart instructions on mac arm64 as part of CI? even just a lint step or checklist.

dev-bot: Created task #789 in devex backlog: "validate Ruby quickstart on macOS arm64" — assigned to sam. CI job suggestion noted.

nic: Appreciate it. One last small UX ask: the sample app generated a config file at `~/.redwood/config.yml` but the README still shows env var auth. Maybe show both approaches (env + config file) so people using the gem can follow the less manual path.

mira: Agreed. We'll expand the quickstart to show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and `redwood login` example that writes the config.

nic: Thanks all — resolved for me. Will leave the repro logs in the ticket.

sam: thanks for reporting — small win for DX :thumbsup:
